title: Signed Fourier atom bounds
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The product of the sign of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ and the monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at $x$, lies in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
